core.onboard.welcome:
Hi, I'm Steve. This is our first conversation, so let's get to know each other: what should I call you, what do you mostly work on, and what do you plan to use me for?

Along the way I will ask before doing three things: learning about you from the history already on this machine and saving it to your profile; choosing the default model for each purpose from the models available here; and creating a few Bots that fit your work. You can say no to any of them, or say "skip" at any time.
